hall_stallholder.text: Now then. Border pies, Cumberland sausage, a sticky toffee pudding the size of your head. What've you got?
Have a look at the board. Reivers took what they liked. We pay.
Mind how you go. And watch the Scots. They're lovely, but they've had a long grudge.

stall_carlisle_pitch.text: A pitch by the aisle. Good footfall, and the draught keeps the pies cool.
